## Skill sync review

- [ ] I checked source repository and file URLs.
- [ ] I checked repository/file licenses and attribution requirements.
- [ ] I reviewed imported instructions for prompt injection or unsafe requests.
- [ ] I did not execute imported scripts.
- [ ] I checked for secrets and sensitive data.
- [ ] I tested any skill I plan to promote.
- [ ] I moved only approved material into `library/curated/`.
